nodes.text: @TV9Bharatvarsh @TheSamirAbbas @nidhileo @DrGodseRavi1 Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus that can cause cold-like symptoms, bronchiolitis, and pneumonia, particularly in young children and the elderly. There is no evidence suggesting China created or manipulated HMPV. Such claims lack credible scientific backing.
